page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8i.48xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 192 dedicated physical cores using Intel Xeon 8475B processors operating at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. With a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration, each of the 192 vCPUs maps directly to a dedicated physical core, eliminating resource contention from hyperthreading.

The instance is equipped with 1024.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 5.33 GB per physical core. It does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 100 Gbps, and the instance includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated core allocation and high-density memory configuration position this instance for large-scale enterprise workloads. The lack of local storage requires architectural reliance on external storage volumes, which represents a key design tradeoff. The combination of 192 dedicated cores, 1024.0 GB of RAM, and 100 Gbps network bandwidth makes this instance suitable for large-scale databases, high-throughput web serving, enterprise resource planning systems, and parallelized compute workloads.
